text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day in October, a bizarre spectacle
unfolds
at the Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! There's so many people,
you'd
think this was a G1 race!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the lineup, no one would
blame you
for assuming it was.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka is competing today. She's
had a
string of victories lately.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, there's the famed
Beast—Grass
Wonder—as well as El
Condor Pasa, hailed as
being the
strongest runner in the classic year...

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Ah, to think I get to watch such an
exciting race! I
was right to make it my
mission to follow these
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka, Grass, and El are all pals of
mine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race kicks off under the watchful
gaze of the
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Try as she might, Grass Wonder is
struggling to
make any ground!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa is coming in from behind,
but she
can't close the gap!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Which leaves Silence Suzuka, refusing to

relinquish the lead all the way to the
finish line!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
She held the lead throughout the whole
race yet
again...

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka's races are all so
memorable—she
knows how to keep the
crowd hooked.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Even though she was already so far
ahead, she
still put on that extra burst at
the end...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There's just somethin' about the way
Suzuka
runs... Wonder what it is?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This must be Silence Suzuka's newfound
style of
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her unique approach captivates the
hearts of
those who witness it.
